stepsToRepeat: Start the application with hourboard_phase4_gate and open two Chrome tabs on the local URL.
Wait for Client A to show the current open round; register a Winner from Client B.
Observe Client A status each frame through registrationClosesAt and confirm the button hides after closure.
Submit a late attempt and compare the response with the database attempt count.
